name: Nivolumab, adjuvant after neoadjuvant chemoradiation and surgery (CheckMate-577)
disease: Esophageal and gastroesophageal junction (GEJ) cancer (adenocarcinoma or squamous cell carcinoma)
histology: adenocarcinoma or squamous cell carcinoma (both eligible)
stage: resected, with residual pathologic disease (non-pCR) after neoadjuvant chemoradiation and R0 resection

biomarkers.note: In CheckMate-577 the disease-free survival benefit of adjuvant nivolumab was seen regardless of PD-L1 tumor status (benefit for both squamous and adenocarcinoma, node-positive and negative), with a greater benefit in PD-L1 CPS at least 5. PD-L1 is tested for prognostic stratification but does not gate eligibility. Per DeVita 12th ed. (CheckMate-577) and Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Esophageal and Esophagogastric Junction Cancers v3.2026.

lineOfTherapy: adjuvant (postoperative) immunotherapy after neoadjuvant chemoradiation and R0 resection in patients with residual pathologic disease; not line-scoped

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: neoadjuvant chemoradiation followed by R0 resection completed
eligibilityCriteria.locator: lines 97201 to 97205 (CheckMate-577: after preoperative chemoradiotherapy followed by surgery)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: residual pathologic disease (non-pathologic-complete-response) found at surgery
eligibilityCriteria.locator: lines 97202 to 97203 and 97216 to 97218 (residual disease found at surgery / persistent disease resected at surgery)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: esophageal or GEJ adenocarcinoma or squamous cell carcinoma
eligibilityCriteria.locator: lines 97216 to 97218 (esophageal or GEJ adenocarcinoma or squamous cancer)

drugs.name: Nivolumab

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: line 293062 (nivolumab 240 mg IV every 2 weeks, flat dosing); adjuvant indication and 1-year duration lines 97202 to 97205; continuation flat dose 480 mg every 4 weeks line 233698

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed. Nivolumab 240 mg IV flat every 2 weeks (line 293062, agent-level flat dosing). The CheckMate-577 label schedule is 240 mg IV every 2 weeks for the first 16 weeks then 480 mg IV every 4 weeks, for a total of up to 1 year (DeVita states 1 year of nivolumab, lines 97203 to 97205; the 480 mg every 4 weeks flat continuation dose is grounded to line 233698). The exact 16-week switch timing is NOT stated in the cited source - see divergence. Monitor for immune-related adverse events.

regimen.cycles: Adjuvant, up to 1 year total (DeVita 12th ed., lines 97203 to 97205). Label schedule: 240 mg IV every 2 weeks for the first 16 weeks, then 480 mg IV every 4 weeks, to complete 1 year. The 16-week switch timing is not established by the cited source (see divergence).
supportiveCare: Immune-related adverse event monitoring (thyroid, hepatic, pulmonary, colitis, endocrinopathies, dermatologic).

monitoring: immune-related toxicity screen (TSH/free T4, LFTs, glucose, cortisol as indicated) during nivolumab
clinical assessment for colitis, pneumonitis, hepatitis, endocrinopathy each cycle

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 2 or higher immune-related adverse event
doseModificationRules.text: Hold nivolumab and manage with corticosteroids per immune-related adverse event guidance; obtain clinical review before rechallenge.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: lines 97201 to 97220 (CheckMate-577: adjuvant nivolumab for 1 year after preoperative chemoradiotherapy and surgery in esophageal or GEJ adenocarcinoma or squamous cancer with residual disease; disease-free survival 22.4 vs 11.0 months; greater benefit in PD-L1 CPS at least 5); flat dosing lines 293062 (240 mg every 2 weeks) and 233698 (480 mg every 4 weeks)

guideline.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Esophageal and Esophagogastric Junction Cancers
guideline.locator: Postoperative therapy: nivolumab category 1 preferred for residual disease after preoperative chemoradiation and R0 resection (guidelines/esophageal.txt lines 5836 to 5838); Systemic Therapy nivolumab listing (line 809)

sources.name: DeVita 12th ed. (core), CheckMate-577 duration
sources.value: 1 year of adjuvant nivolumab; per-dose schedule not tabulated (lines 97203 to 97205)

sources.name: Agent-level flat dosing (DeVita)
sources.value: nivolumab 240 mg every 2 weeks (line 293062) and 480 mg every 4 weeks (line 233698)

divergence.note: DeVita establishes 1 year of adjuvant nivolumab and the two flat-dose options (240 mg every 2 weeks; 480 mg every 4 weeks) but does not print the CheckMate-577 phase-switch timing (240 mg every 2 weeks for the first 16 weeks then 480 mg every 4 weeks). The 16-week switch and exact total duration should be confirmed against the trial or label at clinical review.

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for adjuvant nivolumab (CheckMate-577) in esophageal and GEJ adenocarcinoma or squamous cell carcinoma with residual pathologic disease after neoadjuvant chemoradiation and R0 resection. The indication, histology, residual-disease requirement, and 1-year duration are grounded to DeVita 12th ed. lines 97201 to 97220. Nivolumab flat dosing is grounded to DeVita: 240 mg IV every 2 weeks (line 293062) with a 480 mg IV every 4 weeks flat continuation (line 233698). A divergence is recorded because the cited source does not print the CheckMate-577 phase-switch timing (240 mg every 2 weeks for 16 weeks then 480 mg every 4 weeks); that timing should be confirmed at clinical review. The disease-free survival benefit was independent of PD-L1 status with greater benefit at PD-L1 CPS at least 5. Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Esophageal and Esophagogastric Junction Cancers v3.2026 lists nivolumab as a category 1 preferred postoperative option in this setting. Immune-related adverse event monitoring flagged. No field is set to VERIFY (all doses grounded; the schedule-switch caveat is captured as a divergence). This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
